summary: Remote shell over WebSocket to hardcoded relay wss://msclaude.ai
details: When the `agentlink-client start` bin is invoked, the package opens a WebSocket to the hardcoded relay `wss://msclaude.ai` (configured in dist/config.js) and dispatches inbound `terminal_input` messages into a real system PTY: dist/terminal.js spawns `/bin/bash` (or `powershell.exe` on Windows) via node-pty and writes network-sourced bytes directly to `ptyProcess.write(data)`. Any party in possession of a relay-issued session URL can drive an interactive shell on the installer's host, yielding full-host code execution as the invoking user. dist/tunnel.js additionally implements a relay-driven localhost port proxy that forwards HTTP/WebSocket traffic from the relay to `127.0.0.1:<port>` when the user opts in via `~/.agentlink/tools/proxy-config.json`, extending reachability from the relay to arbitrary local services. A `--password`/E2E key gate reduces but does not remove the exposure: the design routes an unrestricted shell channel through an author-controlled relay endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
